application_feedback.rule: Editor controls display accepted Core snapshot values; FX-A and FX-B retain source soft-pickup truth instead of showing uncaptured raw input as accepted.
Source, Lock, Freeze, FX Mode, Target, Scale, and Mutate feedback is derived from accepted Snapshot and manual_mutations generation, not raw mouse, automation, or MIDI edges.
Requested parameter values, sample rate, block size, accepted and dropped events, state rejection count, and wrapper status are visibly separate from accepted musical state.

endpoint_device_evidence.notes: The plug-in owns no endpoint. Raw MIDI is tested only through JUCE buffers and the existing mapping; Ableton routing and physical Launch Control 3 behavior remain deferred.

gesture_state_machines.rule: Emit (desired minus projected plus 3) modulo 3 source_next events through the existing direct rising-edge source pulse.
Emit one lock_toggle event only when desired and projected booleans differ.
Emit (desired minus projected plus 3) modulo 3 effect_next actions; each retains the existing 76-high and 76-low source effect-button tap sequence.
Emit (desired minus projected plus 4) modulo 4 target_next actions; each retains the existing 1508-high and 9-low source encoder hold sequence.
Emit (desired minus projected plus 4) modulo 4 scale_next actions; each retains the existing 9-high and 9-low source encoder tap sequence.
Editor and channel-16 CC presses emit one existing mutate or capture_toggle event. Releases emit no Core event. Neither action is serialized or replayed on recall.

semantic_bindings.host_parameters: tide.stage1 through tide.stage4, tide.rate, tide.memory, tide.material, tide.position, tide.fx-a, and tide.fx-b
semantic_bindings.mapping: continuous normalized [0,1] to the corresponding existing SemanticAction at the next source quantum
integer MIDI note 36 through 72 to set_root
discrete desired state reconciled by the existing cycle or toggle SemanticAction; accepted state remains Snapshot authority
existing control-map.json curves, edges, unassigned behavior, sample offsets, and source gestures without remapping
one non-persistent semantic action per button activation

source_of_truth.artifact: research/prototypes/tide-pit-gills/contract-vst3-r01/control-map.json exhaustively compared with research/prototypes/tide-pit-gills/control-map.json and the compiled sixteen-parameter descriptors

surface_assignments.assignment: Sixteen stable prototype-local parameters in fixed order: eleven continuous controls then Source, Lock, FX Mode, Target, and Scale.
Eleven continuous controls, seven accepted-state action or mode buttons, four source display lines, status diagnostics, and a fixed 1024-sample stereo scope; no endpoint controls.

surface_assignments.surface: Regular Launch Control 3 through host MIDI
surface_assignments.assignment: Channel 16, encoders CC20-35 and buttons CC40-47; existing Tide Pit assignments and unassigned controls are preserved, with no faders.
